risks.note: An increase in the cost of services, employee benefit expenses, and other operating expenses drove the Company from a profit after tax of Rs. 38.99 lakhs in FY2024-25 to a loss after tax of Rs. 108.31 lakhs in FY2025-26, indicating margin sensitivity to cost inflation in a people-intensive service model.

The Company describes its employees as its key strength and differentiator and operates 'in a highly competitive environment,' making attraction, development and retention of skilled digital-marketing talent a structural dependency for service delivery.
risks.risk: Talent retention in a competitive hiring environment

risks.note: The Chief Financial Officer role changed hands within the year (Ms. Guddi Bharatbhai Chauhan stepped down effective March 26, 2026; Ms. Saumya Milanbhai Yagnik was appointed CFO w.e.f. March 27, 2026), reflecting turnover risk in a critical management position.

The newly incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary, Odigma FZE LLC (Sharjah, UAE), had not commenced business operations and had no audited financial statements as of March 31, 2026; consequently the Company did not prepare consolidated financial statements for FY2025-26, limiting visibility into the international expansion.
